subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through `agents.list` and `agents.create/update/delete`?
rationale: The request changes config shape, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, and live agent/session routing, so source inspection cannot decide the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config and explicit agent-management RPCs, and leave workspace scanning to operator tooling unless a narrower missing core API is identified.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Define a core discovery contract with trusted roots, config filename rules, precedence, validation, reload semantics, and regression/security proof before implementation.

options.title: Move To External Tooling
options.body: Document a supported operator script or plugin-style workflow for generating central agent entries without adding core runtime scanning.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and explicit agent-management RPCs, and leave workspace scanning to operator tooling unless a narrower missing core API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest current history signal on the central agent, config, and gateway surfaces where the product boundary would be set.
